title: Serino 2015 · Experiment 6, sound and touch height
citation: Serino et al. (2015). Body part-centered and full body-centered peripersonal space representations. Scientific Reports, 5, 18603.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.response: Speeded gamepad response to touch. Compare distance-dependent facilitation by sound and tactile heights.

stimulus_type.value: Broadband noise. Synthesis appendix specifies pink noise at 44.1 kHz.
stimulus_type.source: Supplement pp. 3 and 5–9, 16-speaker setup and synthesis appendix

source_provenance.value: Appendix describes identical noise distributed to eight synchronously driven speaker pairs, 2048-sample Hann frames, 1024-sample hop and overlap-add.
source_provenance.source: Supplement pp. 3 and 5–9, 16-speaker setup and synthesis appendix
source_provenance.gap: No rendered waveforms or original implementation identified.

trajectory_path.value: Two opposed trajectories in front at face or sternum height, using 2 m arrays.

stimulus_duration.source: Article pp. 6–8, Experiment 6 and Fig. 5; Article pp. 11–13, Methods
stimulus_duration.gap: 2 m / 0.25 m/s assuming full nominal travel. Exact digital duration unknown.

gain_envelope.source: Supplement pp. 3 and 5–9, 16-speaker setup and synthesis appendix
gain_envelope.gap: Equation 4 evaluates to 60×log10(1/2) dB per doubling; supplement prose instead states −60 dB. Exact implementation not established.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two arrays of eight JBL Control 1 Pro WH speakers, M-Audio FastTrack Ultra 8R and Ecler MPA 4 80R amps. 27.5 cm spacing and 1 m between arrays.
renderer_or_apparatus.source: Supplement pp. 3 and 5–9, 16-speaker setup and synthesis appendix

condition_intermixing.value: Five to seven distance cells depending on experiment. Bimodal and unimodal control families.
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact scheduling across conditions and order unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.gap: Experiment-specific blocks and randomization are recorded when explicitly reported. Exact randomization seeds unknown.

response_window.gap: Online response deadline and exact gamepad key unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond quickly to vibration with designated Xbox 360 gamepad button, sampled at 125 Hz. Ignore the moving cue and withhold on no-touch trials.

soa_table.gap: Distances and nominal motion are reported. Exact software onset times, rendering origin and trigger delays are unavailable.

baseline_strategy.value: Two silent tactile timings equivalent to nearest and farthest bimodal samples. Subtract fastest mean tactile-only RT for each participant's comparison.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory cue with no vibration. Withhold response.

baseline_count.gap: 2 baseline cells × 2 sound directions × 16, using the printed formula.

implementation_gaps: The source gives the spatial probe grid and nominal velocity. Original trigger offsets, propagation delays and position-specific sound envelopes are unavailable.
The delivered vibrotactile waveform, actuator acceleration and synchronized gamepad latency require calibration. The 100 ms pulse is the motor command duration.
The scheduler requires the selected face- or sternum-height trajectory aligned to participant position.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
